tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics.  It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beats Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

When I decide to eat bagels I always make sure that I have an appropriate amount of creme cheese nearby.  Eating dry bagels is a crime against humanity and I will not stand for it.  I hope that nobody has to ever eat a bagel without creme cheese.
